Chief Complaint Follow-up personal history of malignant neoplasm of breast
HPI:
90M with personal history of malignant neoplasm of breast, nicotine dependence, chronic viral hepatitis c presents for routine follow-up. Completed radiation 2 years ago, on aromatase inhibitor. Smoking 1 pack per day. Genotype 1a, treatment naive. Uses oxygen at night and with exertion. Morning stiffness under 30 minutes. No recent ED visits or hospitalizations.
Current Medications:
anastrozole 1 mg tab PO daily
nicotine patch 21 mg/24 hr tab transdermal daily
meloxicam 7.5 mg PO daily
Home Oxygen 2 L/min, via nasal cannula continuous

- varenicline 1 mg - PO BID

Vital Signs: BP 149/78 HR 105 RR 21 SpO2 95% Temp 99.1 Wt 186 lb
Physical Exam: General: NAD, alert. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. No breast masses, well healed scar. No jaundice or ascites. Spo2 88% on room air, 93% on 2 l. Crepitus right knee, no effusion.

1. Personal history of malignant neoplasm of breast, Z85.3 - continue anastrozole; annual mammogram.

3. Chronic viral hepatitis C (B18.2) - start direct acting antiviral; HCV RNA 12 weeks after treatment.

Follow up: PRN

Chief Complaint 3 month recheck morbid (severe) obesity due to excess calories
Subjective:
50-year-old woman with morbid (severe) obesity due to excess calories, obstructive sleep apnea (adult), benign prostatic hyperplasia with lower urinary tract symptoms presents for evaluation. Interested in weight management program. Daytime sleepiness improved. Weak stream. Nocturia 2-3 times nightly. Seizure free for 14 months. Avoiding nsaids. Creatinine stable over the past 6 months. Stable exertional dyspnea, nyha class ii. Weight stable on home scale. No recent ED visits or hospitalizations.
Current Medications:
sodium bicarbonate 650 mg tab PO BID
- tamsulosin 0.4 mg - PO nightly
- carvedilol 12.5 mg - PO BID
levetiracetam 500 mg PO BID
tirzepatide 5 mg subcut weekly
lamotrigine 100 mg PO BID
semaglutide 1 mg subcut weekly
CPAP 10 cm H2O nightly
Drug Allergies: Morphine (itching), Statins (myalgias)
VITALS BP 120/97 HR 71 RR 19 SpO2 98% Temp 100.7 Wt 288 lb
PHYSICAL EXAMINATION Alert and oriented x3. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. Bmi 42.3. Mallampati iv, neck 18 in. Neuro exam nonfocal. Jvp not elevated. Trace bilateral ankle edema. No s3.
Data Reviewed: PSA 2.1, creatinine 1.8, eGFR 36, BNP 412, EF 30% on last echo
Assessment & Plan
Morbid (severe) obesity due to excess calories (E66.01) - medical weight management referral; BMI 40.0-44.9, adult (Z68.41); nutrition counseling provided.
Obstructive sleep apnea (adult) (G47.33) - download reviewed, AHI 3; continue CPAP.
Benign prostatic hyperplasia with lower urinary tract symptoms (N40.1) - PSA annually; continue alpha blocker.
Epilepsy, unspecified, not intractable, without status epilepticus (G40.909) - continue antiseizure medication; no driving restrictions change.
N18.32 - Chronic kidney disease, stage 3b - renally dose medications; nephrology follow up; avoid nephrotoxins.
Chronic systolic (congestive) heart failure I50.22 - continue guideline directed medical therapy; daily weights, call for gain over 3 lb; BMP in 2 weeks.
Follow-up: 3 months
Electronically signed by Paul Escobedo, NP on August 31, 2022 23:23
